parameters.inlet_speed_convention: INLET_MEAN_SPEED is the mean over each inlet; peak = 1.5 * mean
parameters.inlet_profile: parabolic: v_y = -peak * 4 s (1 - s) (downward), v_x = 0, s in [0,1] along each top-wall supply
parameters.nu_kind: spatially constant effective kinematic viscosity (modelling parameter of an idealized 2D experiment); not molecular air viscosity, not a tracer diffusivity
parameters.approx_ach_assumptions: plan-view field = height average; each opening spans the full room height; uniform supply/extract over the height; all air enters via the three inlets
parameters.model_statement: The room experiment uses a steady, two-dimensional airflow with a spatially constant effective viscosity. It provides an idealized setting for evaluating source identification rather than a validated prediction of hospital ventilation.
parameters.layout_attribution: Ventilation arrangement inspired by Fig. 24 and Sec. 7.1 of Lohner et al., arXiv:2006.13792; this three-bed room is an adaptation, not a reproduction, and the paper's bathroom ceiling exhaust is represented by a 2D boundary outlet. Not clinically validated.
parameters.outlet_condition: natural (nu grad v - p I) n = 0 on outlet_door and outlet_exhaust; split not prescribed

natural_outflow_check.note: R(w) = int nu grad u:grad w + ((grad u) u).w - p div w for every P2 basis w at the final iterate. Natural outflow <=> R = 0 on the free outlet dofs (same level as interior dofs: Picard lag + round-off); inlet/wall rows hold the boundary reaction (traction) and are O(reaction).

taylor_hood.sign_convention: flux = int u.n ds with outward n: inflow negative, outflow positive

transport_P1.note: continuous P1 interpolant of the P2 field at mesh vertices; not exactly divergence-free

1.note: per metre depth [m^2/s]; trapezoid on 5 mm samples of the P2 field; negative = net flow from the bay down into the aisle

2.note: per metre depth [m^2/s]; trapezoid on 5 mm samples of the P2 field; negative = net flow from the bay down into the aisle

3.note: per metre depth [m^2/s]; trapezoid on 5 mm samples of the P2 field; negative = net flow from the bay down into the aisle

doorway_flux.note: flux of the P2 field across x = 9, 0.6 < y < 1.4 (interior doorway), trapezoid on 1 mm samples
